authenticity_review: The image demonstrates high-fidelity rendering but exhibits clear AI synthesis artifacts. The fur texture shows characteristic 'airbrushed' transitions between color zones (e.g., grey head to white chest) lacking the chaotic pile variation of real fabric. Structural integrity issues are confirmed by the pose auditor: Instance 4 (baby koala) has an average keypoint confidence of only 0.41, with 10+ low-confidence keypoints in limbs/face, correlating with visually observed melting/fusion in the feet and indistinct digit boundaries. Lighting is unnaturally uniform. These structural and textural anomalies justify a moderate authenticity penalty.
